# moo roadmap

## Fixed-point numbers through the toolchain

Layer 3: every number in moo is Q48.16 fixed point, from the parser and compiler to the bytecode and the VM; the integer and vector types of Luau are removed. Built on the integration branch sprint/moo and merged into main on 2026-10-21.

<!-- nova-work:layer-3:start -->

| feature | moo |
|---|:---:|
| Each layer 3 change has its own test files | ✅ |
| README says what is built | ✅ |
| No vector or integer library is opened | ✅ |
| Vector type removed from the C API, compiler and VM | ✅ |
| Analyzer builtins drop os, vector and integer | ✅ |
| Parser and compiler carry exact raw Q48.16 constants | ✅ |
| Bytecode version and constant folding in fixed point | ✅ |
| Integer arguments refuse a fraction by name, fastcalls included | ✅ |
| The float boundary: tofloat, buffer floats and string.pack floats | ✅ |
| Named overflow errors in checked builds | ✅ |
| Layer 3 conformance oracle, harness and bridge gate | ✅ |
| Upstream merge checklist and its push gate | ✅ |
| Known base failures named; clean compiler warnings | ✅ |
| complete | 100% |

[Source data](docs/roadmap.sexp)

<!-- nova-work:layer-3:end -->

## About this page

Each table lists the features of one area: ✅ is built, tested and landed, with the evidence in the source data; ❌ is not yet. The open rows were sprint cards when the sprint stopped for its pit stop on 2026-10-20; each one names its card, its archived brief and any pushed head in the source data, so the work can be picked up again.
